query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `zernio_posts` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int,
  `raw_caption` text NOT NULL,
  `full_caption` text NOT NULL,
  `platforms` text NOT NULL DEFAULT ('[]'),
  `media_url` varchar(1024),
  `scheduled_at` timestamp NULL,
  `status` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `hashtags` text NOT NULL DEFAULT ('[]'),
  `cta_url` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scrollverse.co/link',
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `zernio_posts_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `zernio_posts_user_id_users_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
